verdict.rationale: Pigment is an FP&A planning platform, so three-statement views with drill-down to source records is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack, however, never documents P&L, balance sheet, or cash flow views, and never documents drilling from a figure to its source records. Generic reporting dashboards, a 'projected year end cash' KPI example, and data-block edit histories are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the model produces P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow views with drill-down from any figure to its source records
